title: “Ultra nerds” are more optimistic about our connected future
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: “Ultra nerds” are more optimistic about our connected future

https://internethealthreport.org/2018/ultra-nerds-are-more-optimistic-about-our-connected-future/

This is very similar to danah boyd's twenty year revisit of JPP's manifesto. People who have never lived in fear have always had an optimistic view of tech.

"Ultra nerd" comes from place of privlidge. Trends white and male. #csethics
